title: effigy.runtime-migration.v1 payload
description: Read-only report on the retired current-main central-store import. v0.15 ships only the v0.14.1 importers, which read legacy files on first use. A committed migration manifest is provenance and the retired store is ignored; without one, a machine still holding it is refused with the exact upgrade path. The command never stages, imports, stops, changes or deletes anything.
